description: Set, change or remove a monthly credit limit on one brand, or on one member of a shared brand (ACCOUNT OWNER ONLY: a brand’s admins and members are refused). When a brand or member would go over its limit this month, paid work there is refused with the numbers and the reset date; free work keeps going and other brands are unaffected. The month is the UTC calendar month. Free.

brand.description: the brand id or name (list_brands); omit for the brand this connection acts on

delegate.description: ACCOUNT OWNER ONLY, sent without limit: true lets this brand’s admins and billing managers set its limits themselves; false takes that back

limit.description: credits per month; null removes the limit; 0 allows no paid work

member.description: a member’s email (list_team) to limit that person on this brand; omit to limit the whole brand

name: set_credit_limit
title: Set a credit limit
